scope: Installed project check --kind content using the pinned toolkit runtime
observations: Actual project Skill and role bodies are inspected; unrelated entrypoint namespaces are reported unassessed.
Deleted complete Skill/role entries are detected against the running package baseline.
Literal resource calls use the package root; relative Markdown links retain their original root and cannot escape it.
Actual project docs resolve; a missing local document does not fall back to the bundle.
Empty or missing package baseline is invalid.
CLI errors use exit 5/CHECK_FAILED; malformed arguments use exit 2; existing prototype checks still work.
Packed fixture restores the exact runtime, invokes the project launcher, and observes a resource root inside the private project runtime.
Packed fixture changes an installed Skill to include an unknown command, observes exit 5 and the project source path, restores exact bytes and observes success.
limitations: Static project content checks do not establish native Skill discovery, role execution, game behavior or human acceptance.
Project mode does not inspect global onboarding, source migration catalogs, or every unreferenced package resource.
No skill-test workflow or migration row is declared complete by this command.
